key_insight: ReAl is a model-agnostic plug-in that improves neural PDE surrogates by refining missing high-frequency details and aligning multi-step rollouts with long-term dynamics.
engineering_relevance: It can upgrade existing physics surrogate models to produce sharper fine-scale predictions without retraining the base architecture from scratch.
method: Refinement: a conditional flow-matching model learns the residual distribution around the base surrogate prediction to recover fine-scale structures.
Alignment: multiple rollout trajectories from the same input are used to generate trajectory-level rewards that reduce long-horizon generative drift.
Designed as a plug-in, so it can augment diverse pretrained PDE surrogate architectures and tasks.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments across diverse surrogate architectures and PDE tasks, showing consistent gains in high-frequency fidelity, forecasting accuracy, and long-horizon stability.
watch_item: Training and using trajectory-level rewards may add sampling and optimization cost, especially for chaotic systems where rollout variability is high.
paper_title: ReAl: Refine neural operators via aligning dynamical flow
